title: Late Fee, Courtesy Waiver and Payment Channel Figures by Schedule — Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
Credit and Collections terms schedule for the Utility Pass-Through Service. The figures below are the schedule's late fee amount, the grace period, the late-fee minimum, the courtesy-waiver allowance, the suspension setting and the accepted payment channels of every service schedule.

## Terms by schedule

| Service schedule | Late fee amount (USD per statement) | Grace period (calendar days after due date) | Late-fee minimum (USD past due) | Courtesy waivers in any trailing 12 months | Service suspension for nonpayment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule | 10.00 | 5 | 10.00 | 1 | Not permitted |
| Submetered Water Schedule | 10.00 | 5 | 10.00 | 1 | Not permitted |
| Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule | 10.00 | 5 | 10.00 | 1 | Not permitted |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule | 12.00 | 5 | 10.00 | 1 | Not permitted |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule | 12.00 | 5 | 10.00 | 1 | Not permitted |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | 15.00 | 5 | 10.00 | 1 | Not permitted |

## Accepted payment channels (identical on all six schedules)

1. Automatic bank draft (autopay) — a scheduled automatic draft from a bank account.
2. One-time bank-account payment in the resident portal (checking or savings).
3. Debit or credit card payment in the resident portal.
4. Money order handed in at the community office.
5. Cashier's check handed in at the community office.
6. Personal check handed in or mailed to the community office.

## Definitions

- **Late fee amount**: the late fee on a statement left unpaid past the grace period, per statement.
- **Grace period**: the calendar days after the due date before a late fee may be charged.
- **Late-fee minimum**: the smallest past-due amount on which a late fee is charged.
- **Courtesy waivers**: the number of utility late fees that may be waived as a courtesy in any trailing 12 months.
- **Service suspension for nonpayment**: whether utility service may be suspended for an unpaid utility balance; it is not permitted on any schedule.

## Points of reading

**Do the grace period and the late-fee minimum differ by schedule?** No; every schedule has a 5-day grace period and a 10.00 dollar late-fee minimum. Only the late fee amount differs: 10.00 on the Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule, the Submetered Water Schedule and the Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule; 12.00 on the natural gas and propane schedules; 15.00 on the electric schedule.
